title: Delgado Trade School, Emmett Hardy and Bill Eastwood
summary: At Delgado he jammed at lunch with Emmett Hardy and Eastwood and played jobs with them.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, Emmett Hardy, come over there.
He was a trained teacher as a matter of fact.
Yeah. Well Emmett Hardy came there. He was studying machinists. And then Bill played out the halfway house with him. Bill Eastwood. Mm-hmm. They were both from Al Jays, you know.

Well, on our intermission, at least around noon, we'd go get our lunch and we'd go out to the street. He'd bring his corner out there and take a pair of sticks and cymbals and so forth. And Eastwood would take his banjo and we'd have a jam session. Mm-hmm. And we had a wonderful time together on our intermission on 12 o'clock lunch. And then later on, I played a couple of jobs with the band, see. And he had Brownlee playing piano and Emmett Hardy playing cornet and so forth. And then later on, later on I played with Eastwood out at, with Abby Brunson and the guys at the halfway house. Mm-hmm. You know, Chris Rubenstein's house at the halfway house.
Yeah, it's still there. It's exterminated.
